critic.review.1.1: Slow service, but the food is honest.
critic.review.1.2: Room to grow. I'll be back.

event.double.title: Double weekend

event.hunt.name: Ingredient hunt

event.hunt.title: Hunt for the golden {0}

game.ice: Frozen: serve more customers to thaw it

garden.text: Crops grow on their own. Every win waters the beds: -{0} min.
garden.title: Supplier's garden
happy.text: Twice a day for 30 minutes: the Big Recipe, the tip jar and the garden go twice as fast.
happy.title: Happy hour
info.bg: A new kitchen background. Put it on in the Kitchen tab, Styles section.
info.chest: Album cards go into the album: every full book gives a prize, the whole album gives the grand prize. Repeats turn into album stars for a star chest.
info.coins: Spend coins on boosters, extra moves after a dead end, kitchen backgrounds and new kitchens.
info.energy: Every item from the oven, grill or crate in the pantry costs 1 energy.
info.energy.title: Pantry energy
info.guest: A special guest in costume. From now on they sometimes come to your levels as a customer.
info.lives: A life is spent when you lose a new level. Lives refill by themselves.
info.lives.title: Lives
info.unlimited: While it lasts, losing a level costs no lives: play as much as you like.
intro.bakery.text: Three bags of flour on one shelf turn into dough. Dough, butter and an egg make croissants.
intro.bakery.title: Fresh pastry
intro.basics.text: Drag products between shelves. Three of the same on one shelf go to the customer who ordered them.
intro.basics.title: Serve the customers
intro.chain.text: Two shelves are chained together. Put a product on one and the other is blocked until the first completes a set. When both have completed a set, the chain falls off.
intro.chain.title: Chained shelves
intro.conflict.text: Sometimes an ingredient is needed both for a set of three and for a recipe. Decide what to cook first.
intro.conflict.title: Choose wisely
intro.dough.text: Three bags of flour on one shelf turn into dough right away. Dough, tomato and mozzarella make a pizza.
intro.dough.title: Knead the dough
intro.gourmet.text: A Gourmet in a top hat comes in the middle of the level and tips five times more while patient. Sometimes he gives a special kitchen background.
intro.gourmet.title: Gourmet
intro.hidden.text: Products with a question mark reveal themselves when their row moves to the front.
intro.hidden.title: Mystery products
intro.ice.text: A product in ice can't be moved. The number shows how many customers to serve before it thaws. You can still complete a set right on top of it.
intro.ice.title: Frozen products
intro.juice.text: Three bunches of grapes on one shelf make juice for a customer who ordered it.
intro.juice.title: Grape juice
intro.key.text: The product on the lock is the key. Serve it to a customer who ordered it, and the shelf opens.
intro.key.title: Lock with a key
intro.limeade.text: Three limes on one shelf make limeade for a customer who ordered it. Limes are also needed for guacamole.
intro.limeade.title: Limeade
intro.lock.text: You can't take from or put on a locked shelf. The number on the lock shows how many customers to serve to open it.
intro.lock.title: Locked shelf
intro.masa.text: Three bowls of masa on one shelf turn into a tortilla right away. Tortilla, beef and salsa make tacos.
intro.masa.title: Corn masa
intro.onigiri.text: Three rice on one shelf become onigiri - but only if someone ordered it. Rice is also needed for sushi and maki, so plan ahead.
intro.onigiri.title: Onigiri
intro.patience.text: Each customer at the counter has a patience bar that drops with every move. Serve them quickly to get a tip on top of the order price: the coin sign above the order shows how much you'll get. Nobody leaves - they just stop tipping.
intro.patience.title: Customers are waiting
intro.recipes.text: Three different ingredients of a recipe on one shelf become a dish. The recipe is shown on the order card.
intro.recipes.title: Cook by recipe
intro.rule.hidden.text: Everything in the back rows is hidden. You'll see a product only when its row moves to the front.
intro.rule.hidden.title: Mystery shelves
intro.rule.noboosters.text: Undo, hint and extra shelf are switched off. Plan every move!
intro.rule.noboosters.title: No boosters this week
intro.rule.recipes.text: Every customer wants a dish. Collect three different ingredients on one shelf.
intro.rule.recipes.title: Recipes only
intro.truffles.text: Three chocolate bars on one shelf make truffles. Chocolate is also needed for eclairs and pain au chocolat.
intro.truffles.title: Chocolate truffles
jar.full: The jar is full! Break it, otherwise new tips have nowhere to go.
jar.text: Part of the coins from every win drops into the jar. Break it to take everything at once.
jar.title: Tip jar
level.title: Level {0}
lives.replay: Replaying levels you've already passed is always free
m3.booster.bomb.text: Starts on the board. Blasts a 5x5 area.
m3.booster.knife.text: Cuts a whole row. Doesn't use a move.
m3.booster.mallet.text: Smashes one tile, crate or ice. Doesn't use a move.
m3.booster.mixer.text: Mixes all products on the board. Doesn't use a move.
m3.booster.pin.text: Starts on the board. Clears a whole row or column.
m3.booster.rainbow.text: Starts on the board. Swap it with a product to clear all products of that kind.
m3.booster.spatula.text: Sweeps a whole column. Doesn't use a move.
m3.chest.title: Chapter chest
m3.intro.basic.text: Swap two neighbors so that 3 or more identical products line up. Collect the products from the goal panel before you run out of moves.
m3.intro.basic.title: Match 3
m3.intro.bomb.text: Match an L or T shape to get a bomb. It blasts everything around in a 5x5 area.
m3.intro.bomb.title: Cherry bomb
m3.intro.carrot.text: Carrots come to the market: now there are six products on the board and matches are harder to find.
m3.intro.carrot.title: New product
m3.intro.combo.text: Swap two specials with each other for a super effect: pin + pin is a cross, pin + bomb clears 3 rows and 3 columns, two donuts clear the whole board!
m3.intro.combo.title: Combos
m3.intro.crate.text: Crates break when you match next to them or hit them with a special. Products fall around them.
m3.intro.crate.title: Crates
m3.intro.crate2.text: Some crates need two hits: the first one knocks off the lid.
m3.intro.crate2.title: Strong crates
m3.intro.crate3.text: These crates hold three hits. Specials are the fastest way to break them.
m3.intro.crate3.title: Iron-bound crates
m3.intro.ice.text: A frozen product can't move. Match it with its neighbors or hit it with a special to break the ice.
m3.intro.ice.title: Ice
m3.intro.ice2.text: Frosty ice takes two hits to break.
m3.intro.ice2.title: Thick ice
m3.intro.jam.text: Clean all the jam: make a match on a stain or hit it with a special.
m3.intro.jam.title: Jam stains
m3.intro.pin.text: Match 4 in a row to get a rolling pin. Tap it or swap it: it clears its whole row or column.
m3.intro.pin.title: Rolling pin
m3.intro.rainbow.text: Match 5 in a row to get a rainbow donut. Swap it with a product and every product of that kind disappears.
m3.intro.rainbow.title: Rainbow donut
m3.intro.whisk.text: Match a 2x2 square to get a whisk. It hits its neighbors and then flies to whatever you need for the goal.
m3.intro.whisk.title: Whisk
m3.lose.title: Level failed
m3.out.lose.streak: You'll lose a life and your win streak.
m3.out.text: Just a little left to collect. Take {0} more moves and finish the level!
m3.out.title: Out of moves
m3.pause.streak: If you leave now, you'll lose a life and your win streak.
m3.pre: Boosters on the board from the start
m3.streak.popup: Win in a row - specials appear on the board at the start. A loss breaks the streak.
m3.streak.title: Win streak: {0}
m3.target.knife: Tap a row to cut it
m3.target.mallet: Tap a tile to smash it
m3.target.spatula: Tap a column to sweep it
m3.title: Market
